goal: Patient-owned continuous monitoring, above-federal security, and reference validation

claims.originating_goal: Build and validate the software evidence pipeline
claims.release_condition: Latest main-branch validation workflow passes and all jobs, logs, security receipts, pipeline receipt, action provenance, and artifact evidence are inspectable, or observed failure/blockage is durably recorded
claims.expected_evidence: GitHub Actions run, jobs, logs, security-profile receipt, security-gate receipt, pipeline receipt, dependency review result when applicable, immutable-action provenance, and uploaded artifact
claims.collision_boundary: Do not create a second POM validation workflow, security profile, risk register, provenance registry, or parallel task registry

claims.release_condition: Threat/risk records, CI gates, encryption and key tests, firmware integrity, access and override tests, recovery tests, incident exercise, independent review, and every activation-evidence item are committed and verified
claims.expected_evidence: Closed critical risks and all activation_evidence entries declared by security_profile.json
claims.collision_boundary: A passing CI run, profile validator, secret scan, dependency review, immutable action pin, or hardware interface document does not constitute production security activation

claims.originating_goal: Construct wearable and PAP evidence hardware
claims.release_condition: Physical components are available; source schematics, firmware build, and enclosure artifacts exist; and the first completed bench receipt is committed
claims.expected_evidence: Firmware build, signed-image and rollback tests, wiring/netlist, enclosure/CAD, measured power and thermal results, completed bench receipt, and simultaneous reference capture
claims.collision_boundary: Interface contracts may be implemented outside the bench lane, but physical, electrical, firmware-security, thermal, and body-worn validation remain owned by the hardware-bench lane

claims.originating_goal: Validate derived measurements against simultaneous reliable devices and laboratory results
claims.release_condition: A hardware or fluid-test session produces synchronized raw and reliable reference data
claims.expected_evidence: Immutable paired dataset, validation report, and acceptance decision
claims.collision_boundary: Synthetic fixtures remain separate and may not be represented as physical validation

session_consolidation.archive_condition: CI evidence is inspected and POM-SW-001 is released, failed, or blocked durably; physical hardware, real-reference, and production-security activation remain assigned to durable lanes
